title: The Hunters Become the Hunted
summary: Xiao Yan's group enters the forest outside the Inner Academy for the Fire Energy Hunting Competition. They watch Sha Tie's Black Demon Group beat a team of new students in one hit, and Xiao Yan judges Sha Tie a Half-Step Dou Ling. Xun Er proposes Xiao Yan as leader, and Hu Jia, Wu Hao and Bai Shan agree for now. Xiao Yan uses Soul Perception to find a weaker senior team, Lin Ge's, and the five beat it and question its members one by one. They learn there are seven senior teams of five, with the Black Demon Group and Luo Hou's White Demon Group the strongest. They also learn that Fire Energy pays for training in the Blazing Sky Qi Refining Tower and that the Strong Ranking is the surest way to earn it. Xiao Yan decides to hunt the seniors for their Fire Energy, but Liu Mu's team then ambushes the group.
events: The Black Demon Group under Sha Tie defeats a group of new students.

Xiao Yan proposes hunting the seniors; Elder Lu approves of his use of the rules.
Liu Mu's team, warned of the newcomers, ambushes them in the woods.
cultivation: Sha Tie, leader of the Black Demon Group, is a Half-Step Dou Ling.
